macros.name: addto
macros.doc: The macro \addto{⟨control sequence⟩}{⟨TeX code⟩} can be used to extend the definition of a macro.

macros.name: AfterBabelLanguage
macros.doc: Executes ⟨code⟩ when the file loaded by the corresponding package option is finished (at \ldf@finish).

macros.name: babelcharclass
macros.doc: Declares a new character class, which is assigned to the characters in {⟨char-list⟩}, entered either as characters or in macro form (e.g., \}).

macros.name: BabelContentsFiles
macros.doc: This macro contains a list of “toc” types requiring a command to switch the language.

macros.name: babelhyphenation
macros.doc: Sets hyphenation exceptions for the languages given or, without the optional argument, for all languages (e.g., proper nouns or common loan words, and of course monolingual documents).

macros.name: babelsublr
macros.doc: This command is provided to set {⟨lr-text⟩} in L mode if necessary.

macros.name: DisableBabelHook
macros.doc: Hooks with a certain {⟨name⟩} may be enabled and disabled for all defined events with \EnableBabelHook{⟨name⟩}, \DisableBabelHook{⟨name⟩}.

macros.name: EnableBabelHook
macros.doc: Hooks with a certain {⟨name⟩} may be enabled and disabled for all defined events with \EnableBabelHook{⟨name⟩}, \DisableBabelHook{⟨name⟩}.

macros.name: enablelocaleinterchar
macros.doc: Enable or disable the interchar rules with the given label for the current language.

macros.name: ensureascii
macros.doc: This macro makes sure 〈text 〉 is typeset with a LICR-savvy encoding in the ASCII range.

macros.name: flq
macros.doc: The ‘french’ single guillemets.

macros.name: foreignlanguage
macros.doc: It takes two mandatory arguments; the second argument is a phrase to be typeset according to the rules of the language named in its first one.

macros.name: frq
macros.doc: The ‘french’ single guillemets.

macros.name: getlocaleproperty
macros.doc: The value of any locale property as set by the ini files (or added/modified with \babelprovide) can be retrieved and stored in a macro with this command.

macros.name: glqq
macros.doc: The ‘german’ double quotes.

macros.name: grq
macros.doc: The ‘german’ single quotes.

macros.name: grqq
macros.doc: The ‘german’ double quotes.

macros.name: languageattribute
macros.doc: This is a user-level command, to be used in the preamble of a document (after \usepackage {babel}), that declares which attributes are to be used for a given language.

macros.name: languageshorthands
macros.doc: A user level command to change the language from which shorthands are used.

macros.name: LocaleForEach
macros.doc: There is a loop named \LocaleForEach to traverse the list, where #1 is the name of the current item, so that \LocaleForEach{\message{ **#1** }} just shows the loaded ini’s.

macros.name: localeid
macros.doc: Each language in the babel sense has its own unique numeric identifier, which can be retrieved with \localeid.

macros.name: localeinfo
macros.doc: If an ini file has been loaded for the current language, you may access the information stored in it.

macros.name: localename
macros.doc: The control sequence \localename contains the name of the current locale.

macros.name: selectlanguage
macros.doc: When a user wants to switch from one language to another he can do so using the macro \selectlanguage.

macros.name: shorthandoff
macros.doc: The command \shorthandoff sets the \catcode for each of the characters in its argument to other (12); the command \shorthandon sets the \catcode to active (13).

macros.name: shorthandon
macros.doc: The command \shorthandoff sets the \catcode for each of the characters in its argument to other (12); the command \shorthandon sets the \catcode to active (13).

macros.name: ShowBabelTransforms
macros.doc: Applies the current transforms to the string and shows in the log the transformations performed.

macros.name: ShowLocaleProperties
macros.doc: Prints to the log file all the loaded key/value pairs from the ini locale file for ⟨language⟩.

macros.name: useshorthands
macros.doc: It initiates the definition of user-defined shorthand sequences.

macros.name: minus
macros.doc: minus sign

envs.name: hyphenrules
envs.doc: The environment hyphenrules can be used to select only the hyphenation rules to be used (it can be used as command, too).
